notes: ⚠️ JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED SITE - Requires Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer. This is a Vue.js application (bhhs.com) that loads property listings dynamically via API calls after page load. The HTML structure contains 13 empty article elements that get populated by JavaScript. Static HTML scraping returns 0 data. The URL structure supports pagination via Page parameter (&Page=1, &Page=2, etc.) and PageSize parameter (&PageSize=32). This is a commercial/business properties search page filtered by PropertyType=1,2 and ApplicationType=FOR_SALE. The site uses the 'cmp-property-card' component pattern (based on AEM framework class naming conventions). To scrape successfully: 1) Use browser automation (Playwright recommended), 2) Wait for article elements to populate with data, 3) Extract using the selectors provided above, 4) Increment Page parameter for pagination.
